definitions.explanation: Childish or crude word for vomit. Very common in everyday speech, especially among children, but considered vulgar in formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がげろを{吐|は}いて{泣|な}いている。
examples.english: The child threw up and is crying.

notes:
REGISTER: Childish/vulgar. Very commonly used in everyday speech but inappropriate in formal contexts. Adults may use this word casually with friends or family.

ALTERNATIVES: More polite alternatives include {嘔吐|おうと} (medical/formal) and {吐|は}いたもの (general).

RELATED VERB: げろを{吐|は}く (to vomit) or simply げろる (slang verb form).
